title: Trade fair city of Cologne
html:
Two landmarks of Cologne: The Hohenzollern Bridge and the Cologne Cathedral

Shines bright day and night: The Cologne Cathedral

With its 157.39 meters the Cologne Cathedral is the second highest church building in Europe.

In the immediate vicinity of the exhibition center, the Köln Messe/Deutz station connects you with regional and interregional rail services.

In constant change and always well visited: the Schildergasse is the main shopping street in Cologne.

The most heavily used railway bridge in Germany connects Cologne main station and Köln Messe/Deutz station.

Take advantage of the countless opportunities of the beautiful Cathedral city. Shopping tours, wellness and sports offers combined with Cologne hospitality and gaiety will turn your stay into an unforgettable experience.

Cologne has a lot to offer. Inform yourself about the sights (map as PDF with markings) and events on these pages:
